title: AWS Step Functions to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime with a task-token callback
description: Invoke an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime agent from AWS Step Functions with Request Response, or with a task-token callback for work longer than 15 minutes.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime agent and two AWS Step Functions state machines that invoke it through the AWS SDK service integration for InvokeAgentRuntime.

The Request Response state machine waits for the agent's response, for up to 15 minutes. The callback state machine appends .waitForTaskToken and passes the task token in the payload. The agent returns immediately, runs its work in the background, and resumes the workflow with SendTaskSuccess, or with SendTaskFailure on error. The callback pattern works in Standard workflows only.

One agent serves both state machines: without a task token it answers inline, and with a token it calls back. The pattern deploys one AgentCore Runtime agent from a code zip in Amazon S3, its execution role, and two Standard state machines with their roles.
